protocol.selection_scope: fixed CD-HIT 0.80 group-aware five-fold OOF before frozen historical tests

cross_view_consistency_oof.architecture: fold-pure base geometry SSL refined by ESMFold-to-PepFlow/AF2 residue consistency and ensemble median-distance/contact-occupancy objectives, then hierarchical ProtT5-to-3D bounded residual fusion
cross_view_consistency_oof.oof_decision: Passed the minimum OOF screen and proceeded once to frozen fold-paired historical-test evaluation.

cross_view_fold_ensemble_historical_test.decision: Rejected: Test1 MCC fell from the current default 0.86113 to 0.85426 and Test2 ranking also worsened.

agreement_reliability_gate_oof.decision: Rejected before historical tests because fold stability failed the 4-of-5 non-degradation gate.

length_confidence_group_dro_oof.decision: Rejected before historical tests because MCC, AUPRC and Brier did not exceed the current default.

final_decision.default_remains: ProtT5-query 3D chemical interaction hybrid at ProtT5/structure=0.62/0.38 and threshold=0.60
final_decision.scientific_conclusion: Cross-generator consistency helps the covered 1-30 aa domains but does not transfer to low-confidence or uncovered long-peptide structure domains. The bottleneck is structural domain coverage, not a missing fusion head.
final_decision.next_priority: Obtain generator-overlap views within the same length strata, especially PepFlow/AF2 or another ensemble source for 31-50 aa, and validate on a genuinely new frozen external set before any further fusion search.
